reviewItem.question: Does "Standardization of the peer metadata attributes: CEL expressions in the telemetry API must use the standard Envoy attributes instead of the custom Wasm…" mean a change to migration:istio|name=telemetry-cel-peer-metadata-attributes (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: Telemetry API CEL expressions must be updated to use standard Envoy attributes (filter_state.downstream_peer/upstream_peer, xds.node, fully qualified wasm.* attributes) instead of the custom Wasm extended attributes.
